title: Hardys, Dudleys and Edge & Christian: the TLC rivalry
summary: Three teams compete for the tag titles by escalating the risks. Ladder matches develop into the Tables, Ladders and Chairs format.

chapters.title: Three teams meet on ladders
chapters.result: Edge and Christian win the tag titles against the Hardys and Dudleys.
chapters.context: The Triangle Ladder Match establishes the three-team championship rivalry.

chapters.title: The first TLC match
chapters.result: Edge and Christian retain against the Hardys and Dudleys.
chapters.context: Tables and chairs join ladders as the defining match format.

chapters.title: TLC returns to WrestleMania
chapters.result: Edge and Christian win the tag titles in TLC II.
chapters.context: The three teams stage another championship confrontation.
